biotools.summary: CRE is an R package implementing the Causal Rule Ensemble method for interpretable discovery and inference of heterogeneous treatment effects. It provides a flexible implementation of ensemble-of-trees approaches to identify subgroups where treatments have notably different effects, supporting various IATE estimators.
